gates.name: linux_build_and_tests
gates.evidence: CI Linux GCC, Clang and Physics jobs build and run the full unit tests and ctest suite; green on PRs 207-211 (Actions run 38331503811 for 208)

gates.name: sanitizers
gates.evidence: CI Linux ASan+UBSan job runs the suite and is required; the TSan job is advisory and has been green on the same runs

gates.name: module_boundaries
gates.evidence: tools/check_module_graph.py runs in the Linux and Windows jobs (no cycles, layer rule holds); tests/fixtures/module_graph_cycle.dot proves it catches a cycle

gates.name: fuzz_corpora
gates.evidence: every job runs the fuzz_replay_* ctests over the checked-in corpora (pak, scene, Blueprint, save, input, UI, sprite2d, plugin, files, AI and more); the Clang fuzz job is advisory

gates.name: benchmark_regressions
gates.evidence: the Linux GCC job (RelWithDebInfo) runs aether_bench against bench/baseline.json at tolerance 3.0; the baseline was regenerated from CI numbers (docs/design/PERFORMANCE.md) because the old one came from a different build and flagged a benchmark that had got faster. The step is still advisory (continue-on-error); it becomes a gate once a few runs show the runner's spread and it is made required

gates.name: serialization_migrations
gates.evidence: docs/design/format_versions.txt and tests/test_format_versions.cpp (every JSON loader refuses a newer file); tests/test_legacy_files.cpp loads 41 real files from earlier tools (tests/fixtures/legacy/baseline-bd9cb13/); the binary scene v1->v2 migration is covered. No other format has bumped its version yet, so no other migration exists to test

gates.name: multiplayer_soak
gates.evidence: tests/test_net_replication.cpp Replication_SixtyFourPlayersConvergeThroughLoss: 64 clients, 5% loss, latency and jitter, a shared 64 kB/s cap, 10 simulated seconds of movement; every client converges to the server world. tools/soak also gates heap growth. Real networks are not covered

gates.name: platform_builds
gates.evidence: Windows (MSVC, D3D12, Qt editor) and macOS (MoltenVK) jobs pass; Android and iOS have no jobs yet (docs/design/MOBILE_READINESS.md)

gates.name: sample_games
gates.evidence: Coin Run, Gem Hop, Stardust Hop and the frozen-API Lantern Run build and run; still missing: a packaged playthrough of each on a release build

gates.name: release_artifacts
gates.evidence: docs/releases/NEXT.md and the upgrade guide are drafts; no checksums, signing or support policy yet (docs/manual/support_policy.md is a proposal)

gates.name: m8_product_validation
gates.evidence: M8.1-M8.12 evidence table, AETHER-01 packaged playthrough, and external developer task study
